title: Cognate set
description: One meaning, with the related (cognate) word in each language. Every form must cite a source.

proto.description: Optional reconstructed ancestor form. Reconstructions are hypotheses and need a source too.

script.description: Word in its own script, where it can be typed (Pashto, Bactrian).

gloss.description: Only if the meaning differs from the set's gloss.

source.description: ID of a file in data/sources/.

locator.description: Dictionary entry or page, e.g. 's.v. nāman-' or 'p. 123'.

status.description: verified = someone looked up this exact form in this exact source.

notes.description: Plain-language explanation, e.g. of sound changes visible in the set.

notes_sources.description: Sources for the claims made in `notes`. Without these, notes are shown as unsourced observations.

claims.description: IDs of claims this set is evidence for.
